findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tavily_search, verify_email · Private data: verify_domain, verify_email, verify_dns · Public sink: tavily_search, verify_email, translate_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tavily_search, verify_email · Private data: verify_domain, verify_email, verify_dns · Public sink: tavily_search, verify_email, translate_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
